applicabilityBasis.summary: Gate markets GUSD as a principal-protected yield product, but it is also fixed at a 1:1 subscription and redemption rate, transferable, tradable, and usable as collateral. Public materials do not identify the legal issuer or instrument terms needed to determine whether GUSD is a GENIUS payment stablecoin or an excluded security or investment product.

genius.notes: Gate describes GUSD as a principal-protected investment unit with daily GUSD distributions, 1:1 minting and redemption in USDT, USDC or USD1, trading and collateral uses. IPO Access also accepts GUSD for subscription settlement. The documented redemption assets are other digital assets, not a proven issuer obligation to pay a national currency or bank deposit under GENIUS Section 2(22). Yield alone does not establish a security exclusion. The legal issuer, issuer domicile and enforceable instrument rights remain unidentified in the opened product pages and group User Agreement; no issuerEntity is set. Gate publishes qualitative income/backing claims but the opened materials do not provide a dated token-specific reserve reconciliation or monthly independent reserve attestation. The exchange proof-of-reserves description concerns customer balances and platform holdings and is not treated as a GUSD-backing attestation. The global User Agreement excludes U.S. persons; this does not establish availability through a separate Gate U.S. regional entity. GENIUS authorization negative evidence is dated 2026-10-07; no global assertion about approvals for other issuers is made.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS approval, state-qualified designation, official application or foreign registration naming Gate GUSD and Gate was found in the opened regulatory materials and targeted official-domain searches as of 2026-10-07. The sources checked contain proposals or procedural implementation rather than an authorization for this token. NYDFS Greenlist GUSD denotes Gemini Dollar, not Gate GUSD. This is bounded negative evidence, not proof that no confidential or unindexed application exists.
